title: FlowApplyOutput
description: Output of `gentry flow apply --json`: the draft of the flow of the project, its flow directory and the shared subagents, became active with one commit of the process repository.

applied.description: The commit that applied the flow.

projects.description: The other projects whose active flows name the shared subagents the commit changed, sorted; empty if it changed none or no other project names them.

sent.description: Whether the commit is sent to the remote repository; false without one or when it did not answer, and then it is sent by a later command.

sync.description: What the synchronization of the command did; present only when there is something to tell.

agents.description: What the layout of subagents in the free worktrees of the project and of the other projects in projects did; present only when there is something to tell.
